0022600202.text: The Miami Heat (3-6) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-8) for their 10th game of the season, sitting 9th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 3 games back, with a 3-6 mark over their last ten and a one-game losing streak. Sacramento is 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 6.5 games back, and enters on a two-game losing streak with a 0-4 home record, missing Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee), while Domantas Sabonis is day-to-day with knee soreness and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have no games yet in 2026-27, and Miami's most recent meeting was a 130-117 Heat win in Sacramento on January 20, 2026.
